verification_report.summary:
The complete proof is correct under the expressly accepted inputs. All 14 sequential audit items and four reference checks pass. Matrix AM–GM and Stokes give the exact bound ||k_T||_{np/(np-1)} <= c_p^(-1/n), covering precisely 1<q<n/(n-1). Absolute continuity of the determinant measure forces det P_T=0 on the singular trace part, without implying absolute continuity of T.

The endpoint supremum is exactly v_-(omega)^(-1/n), with the same supremum over smooth forms and value +infinity when v_-=0. The conformal Gauduchon construction supplies the equality tests; its standard existence theorem matches [Pan, introduction](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.06259). Each endpoint norm is independent of dV. No BMP or compact duality is used in these determinant theorems.

The adjoint bound has the correct factor e^(2R/n)M(0)^(-1), using only the accepted representation. The separate weak_gauduchon_duality_01 audit completed with verdict correct during this run. The Hopf form T_0=omega^2/6 attains the endpoint value 6^(-1/3), despite infinite upper mass.

Full deduction and reference details are saved in results/gauduchon_determinant_integrability_01/verification_report.md and the run memory. The book was not edited.
